sources.portwatch_vi_data: PortWatch VI: Does GTA VI run on PC yet? Skip to the leaderboard PortWatch VI Race News Watchlist Toolkit Scoring Fake downloads Loading… Live tracker Follow on X Star on GitHub Does GTA VI run on PC yet? Not yet. Every serious attempt to recompile, emulate or port the leaked Xbox Series build to PC, scored on one scale from groundwork to a game you can play to the end. Executable drop -- days : -- hours : -- min : -- sec Pinned 4 4lwayz Creator Overall progress · closest effort to playable 0 %   - Furthest milestone - Top-3 average - Boot GTA VI - Efforts tracked What changed Leaderboard The race The efforts with public code, ranked by how close each is to running the game. Scores come from each project's public README, commits and issues. Self-reported claims are labelled. Private builds are listed below the race, without a rank. All GTA VI-specific Any-game layers Sort Progress Stars Recently active Private builds · not ranked These have no public code, so nobody outside the group can check or run them. Each one names the public project it builds on, and that project keeps its place in the race. What's happening News The moves that matter around the leak: takedowns, confirmed leaks, legal news and scams. Short summaries in our own words, with links to the original reporting. All news × Early or stalled Watchlist Real but early projects: scaffolding, research probes or a different route. They move up to the race when they ship something you can measure. The asset side Toolkit These won't run the game, but every port leans on them: archive explorers, texture codecs and format notes. Spotted by the scout New candidates Every 3 hours the scout searches GitHub, GitLab, Hacker News, Bluesky, Mastodon, Lemmy and 4chan (/v/, /vg/) for new efforts. Repos with real code are listed here until they're reviewed. They are deliberately not linked, and copies of tracked projects are filtered out. There is no download No project on this page hosts the game, keys or an executable, and this site never links to any. Anything offering a ready-to-play GTA VI for PC this week is a scam. Methodology How the progress bar works One scale for every project, in two parts. Getting in is a ladder to 50%: groundwork fills the first 10%, then each step needs the one before it, up to Playable. Playing well fills the rest: how far you can play, how right it looks, how fast it runs and how long it keeps running. 100% is the whole game, finished. Groundwork, weighted Partial steps, such as a menu that renders but is broken, count half. The four tracks only count once a build is Playable: you can't judge how well a game plays before you can play it. Maintain a project and think it's mis-scored? Open an issue with a link to your evidence. PortWatch VI Fan-made tracker. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games, Take-Two or Microsoft. Grand Theft Auto and related marks belong to their owners. No game files, keys or executables are hosted or linked here. Data: tracker.json , refreshed every 3 hours by the scout.
sources.gta6_pc_race_data: GTA VI PC Race: live tracker of unofficial PC ports Skip to content G GTA VI PC Race Standings Forecast Updates Method See the standings GTA VI PC port tracker Playable: no. victory-fork, a public fork of VIctory, is furthest, at stage 6 of 7. Sixteen open-source projects and two private builds are trying to run the game’s Xbox build on a PC. This page reads their public repositories every 15 minutes and says how far each has got. Checked 21:33 UTC on 24 Nov . See the standings Read the latest update Stages reached 21:33 UTC 7 Playable 6 In-game victory-fork, AnyXboxX, omonkey, CGBJ, VIctory 5 Recognisable picture five-star-recomp, XCL, OpenScarlett (Community Edition), PercyScarlett, Xbox2Windows, OpenScarlett, TuxBox, GTA6-BootTest, g6shim 4 First frames Leonida, Holy-Interoperability, palmetto 3 Graphics device xbox-emulator 2 Starts up 1 Loads Best estimate to playable about 3 days Standings 1 victory-fork Fork of VIctory, formerly named victory-gta6 Stage 6 of 7: In-game Its README reports the first gameplay scene with characters, textures, sky and sunlit surfaces at 2.5 to 4 frames a second on an RTX 4070, with the HUD, pause menu and controller input working and everything in shadow still black. PortWatch reports its developer's live streams showing ray-traced lighting at about 3 frames a second, and AnyXboxX's maintainer has run it on a second machine. Source: project README, PortWatch's reports of its developer's live streams, and AnyXboxX's notes from a second machine. Changed 21:13 UTC . 2 AnyXboxX Builds on VIctory, now through victory-fork Stage 6 of 7: In-game Runs on victory-fork, which puts the world on screen. Its maintainer measures up to 5.4 frames a second on an RTX 4070 SUPER and played for about 13 minutes before one device loss, and its notes relay a third-party report of 21.5 minutes without a fault on an RTX 4060 Ti. Source: project README and run notes, observed by the maintainer on one machine. Changed 21:13 UTC . 3 omonkey Private build based on victory-fork. No public code Stage 6 of 7: In-game PortWatch reports this build running at about 5 frames a second in the opening prison scene, where a player can walk around slowly. It is built on victory-fork, and nobody outside can test it. Source: portWatch, which reports watching the work on live streams. Not the developer's own statement. Changed 20:31 UTC . 4 CGBJ Private build based on VIctory, with some of XCL's work. No public code Stage 6 of 7: In-game Press reports put this build in the game world, where a player can walk, talk to characters and open the menu. It is unlit and very slow, the run with walking had a black screen, and nobody outside the group can test it. Source: portWatch, which says it checked that the build gets in game, and DSOGaming. Not the group's own statement. Changed 13:10 UTC . 5 VIctory Runs the game's Xbox code natively on Windows Stage 6 of 7: In-game Open pull requests report the world staying up for 8 minutes under Proton on Linux, with geometry visible through a debug view and a player walking the first mission's street, and for more than 6 minutes on an NVIDIA RTX 4080 Super. The project's README still describes the scene after the title card as dark, at 0.5 to 1.8 seconds a frame. Source: open pull requests by contributors, each measured on one machine, and the project README, which has not caught up. Changed 17:14 UTC . 6 five-star-recomp GTA VI recompilation toolchain Stage 5 of 7: Recognisable picture Shows every first-run screen, loads story mode and plays the opening cutscene's art, credit cards, dialogue and sound at a steady 30 frames a second. The cutscene's 3D world does not draw yet. Source: project status page. Changed 21:33 UTC . 7 XCL Compatibility layer for Xbox Series games Stage 5 of 7: Recognisable picture Shows the game's menus and settings at a steady 30 frames a second, and its own status line says gameplay is not reached. Before it switched to other code, the fork Palmwave took XCL's code as far as drawing the first mission's world into its buffers. Source: maintainer's notes and commits on the main branch. Changed 21:33 UTC . 8 OpenScarlett (Community Edition) Compatibility layer for Xbox Series games, separate from the other OpenScarlett Stage 5 of 7: Recognisable picture Runs a newer retail game it does not name through its first-boot settings and legal screens, start screen and 4K intro video with sound, at a steady 30 frames a second. It stops while the scene behind the menus streams in. Source: project README, tested on one machine. Changed 06:54 UTC . 9 PercyScarlett Xbox Series compatibility layer Stage 5 of 7: Recognisable picture Shows the account picker, video playback in full colour and the first-time setup screens on an unmodified executable, and reports world streaming after them. It has withdrawn its screenshots and no longer names the title. Source: project README, and a screenshot this page checked before the project withdrew it. Changed 08:30 UTC . 10 Xbox2Windows Translation toolchain for Xbox Series games Stage 5 of 7: Recognisable picture With a modified diagnostic copy of the executable and a debugger set to continue past assertions, a run on an RTX 4060 laptop played the intro video, got through setup and reached loading. analysis.ai_summary: The unofficial GTA VI PC port race continues to advance at Stage 6, with victory-fork maintaining its lead by rendering the first gameplay scene with character models, textures, and sunlit surfaces. Upstream core repositories like VIctory and XCL maintain high commit velocities exceeding 50 daily commits each, while downstream efforts such as AnyXboxX and private builds like omonkey achieve stable test runs exceeding 13 minutes.
analysis.prediction: victory-fork and upstream project VIctory are projected to resolve shadow lighting anomalies and achieve a stable basic playable loop within the upcoming months.

leaderboard.name: victory-fork
leaderboard.highest_achievement: Rendered first gameplay scene with characters, textures, sky, and sunlit surfaces with working HUD and controller input.
leaderboard.work_today_note: Pushed world rendering forward with live-streamed ray-traced lighting verification on an RTX 4070.
known_issues: Very low performance (2.5 to 4 frames per second)
Everything in shadow remains completely black

leaderboard.name: AnyXboxX
leaderboard.highest_achievement: Successfully ran the game via victory-fork reaching up to 5.4 FPS and maintaining sessions for over 13-21 minutes.
leaderboard.work_today_note: Logged extended stability sessions and multi-machine cross-verification notes.
known_issues: Low frame rates requiring host-side optimizations

leaderboard.name: omonkey
leaderboard.highest_achievement: Private build running at ~5 FPS in the opening prison scene with slow character walkability.
leaderboard.work_today_note: Observed via PortWatch live streams executing initial prison scene navigation.
known_issues: Closed-source private build unavailable for independent testing

leaderboard.name: VIctory
leaderboard.highest_achievement: Ran Xbox code natively on Windows and Linux via Proton, maintaining world uptime for up to 8 minutes with geometry visible.
leaderboard.work_today_note: Logged 50 commits focusing on state machine stability and upstream infrastructure.
works: Native Xbox code execution on Windows/Linux
known_issues: Extremely slow frame delivery (0.5 to 1.8 seconds per frame)

leaderboard.name: five-star-recomp
leaderboard.highest_achievement: Loaded story mode and played opening cutscene art, credit cards, dialogue, and audio at a steady 30 frames per second.
leaderboard.work_today_note: Maintained steady toolchain updates for recompilation pipelines.
known_issues: 3D world geometry does not draw yet during cutscenes

news_highlights.headline: victory-fork achieves milestone status 6 with live stream evidence showing ray-traced lighting and character models.
AnyXboxX maintainer reports over 13 minutes of continuous execution on an RTX 4070 SUPER before a device loss.
VIctory surpasses 11,000 stars with aggressive daily commit velocity focused on state machine stabilization.
